method: Bounded direct-domain Python smoke; actual Feed native events, AnalyticsEngine, AlertEngine, compare_pair. No pytest test runner, build, lint, formatter, network, or mock engine.

conditions.same_id_update: Fire spread rule at t=1 with cooldown=10; update the same ID threshold from 100 to 150 at the same cutoff; observe t=2, rearm at t=3, observe t=4 and t=11; reset/replay the command history.
conditions.oversized_metric: Analytics window=202ns, max_references=400; deliver 203 native quote observations with increasing bid quantity. Exact event OFI has 202 supporting references.
conditions.nested_records: Construct immutable evaluation replacements with 201 nested metric trade references or displayed references; both must reject.
conditions.deep_pair: Actual compare_pair walks 201 known ask levels for base quantity=201 using sourced explicit 0.001 fee schedules. Underlying comparison remains eligible; alert suppresses oversized retained pair evidence.

policy: Same-ID updates retain the existing latch and last-fire time. Oversized nested metric/display/pair evidence is rejected, not truncated; unavailable evaluations expose explicit evidence-limit reasons and omit oversized objects.
verification_scope: Only the bounded direct-domain smoke above was executed. Added regressions remain for parent union gate.
